gate_definitions.name: Official-source integrity
gate_definitions.criterion: Every input value comes from an official league, team or network source and every row carries that source URL. No secondary aggregator, no news summary, no inferred value.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: A signal built on an unsourced or mis-transcribed input cannot be audited, and every downstream statistic inherits the error.

gate_definitions.name: Minimum sample size
gate_definitions.criterion: At least 100 settled, priced bets for the strategy before it may be scored or ranked.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Below this size the sampling error on any edge estimate is larger than the edge itself, so a lucky run is indistinguishable from skill.

gate_definitions.name: Out-of-sample (walk-forward) test
gate_definitions.criterion: Performance is measured on games that were played after the signal timestamp; no random shuffle, no in-sample fitting, no feature computed from information published after the line was originated.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: NFL data is autocorrelated and small samples; in-sample fitting manufactures skill that does not exist.

gate_definitions.name: Multiple-testing correction
gate_definitions.criterion: The number of strategies tested is declared and a Holm-Bonferroni correction (or deflated Sharpe ratio) is applied to the significance threshold before a strategy is called profitable.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Testing many variations of the same idea guarantees that some look profitable by chance.

gate_definitions.name: Statistical significance and confidence interval
gate_definitions.criterion: The 95% bootstrap confidence interval for expected edge must exclude zero in the positive direction, and the number of bets must exceed G2.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: An edge that cannot be distinguished from zero is not an edge.

gate_definitions.name: Luck / variance control
gate_definitions.criterion: The signal is tested against a variance-matched null: the edge must survive controlling for opponent strength, schedule features and one-game noise, and the persistence measured from official season data must explain less variance than the signal itself.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Most year-to-year NFL movement is luck. A strategy that only wins when the coin flip goes its way is not a strategy.

gate_definitions.name: Correlation and effective sample size
gate_definitions.criterion: Legs combined in one ticket must have measured |rho| <= 0.30, the ticket is capped at 4 legs, and the reported sample size is the effective sample size n_eff = n / (1 + (k-1) * mean_rho).
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Correlated legs do not multiply independent edges; they multiply one edge and multiply the variance.

gate_definitions.name: Robustness across sub-periods and thresholds
gate_definitions.criterion: Positive result in at least 60% of seasons tested, and the sign of the edge does not flip when the entry threshold is moved within the stated band.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: A result that depends on one season or one hand-picked threshold is a fit to noise.

gate_definitions.name: Price availability and line-movement discipline
gate_definitions.criterion: A bet is only recorded when a price exists at the origination timestamp, with the bookmaker/price source and timestamp stored; the line must have been stable for the stated minimum window.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Without a recorded price there is no edge and no settlement; stale prices are not tradeable prices.

gate_definitions.name: Risk limits
gate_definitions.criterion: Kelly fraction per bet <= 0.25, weekly exposure cap, and no parlay longer than 4 legs or combining two legs from the same game.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: A correct signal with uncontrolled sizing still produces ruin.

gate_definitions.name: Provenance and disclosure
gate_definitions.criterion: Every bet record stores the input values, their official source URLs and the capture timestamps, and the site publishes the model parameters used.

gate_definitions.name: Settlement integrity
gate_definitions.criterion: Bets settle on the official final score from an official source, with pushes handled as pushes and voided games excluded.
gate_definitions.why_it_matters: Leaderboard points computed from anything other than the official result are not comparable between strategies.

gates.criterion: Kelly fraction per bet <= 0.25, weekly exposure cap, and no parlay longer than 4 legs or combining two legs from the same game.
gates.evidence: Configured in the leaderboard rules.

gates.criterion: Every bet record stores the input values, their official source URLs and the capture timestamps, and the site publishes the model parameters used.
gates.evidence: Rows carry the official depth-chart and injury-report URLs.

gates.criterion: Bets settle on the official final score from an official source, with pushes handled as pushes and voided games excluded.
gates.evidence: No originated line has settled yet.
